answer.rationale: With the line at 94% committed volume and no buffer, an immediate primary-vendor migration creates disproportionate delivery and qualification risk despite the low-cost quote meeting the spend target. Preserve incumbent continuity while urgently benchmarking and negotiating price, payment, and multi-year volume terms. Verify the prior negotiation record to assess whether incumbent concessions can credibly approach the required 18% reduction within the 14-day window. If that cannot be established, the mandate-versus-continuity tradeoff remains unresolved rather than assuming the switch is safe.
